Diem was a stablecoin-oriented payment blockchain project that was originally announced as Libra. Diem used the Move programming language for its smart contracts. Diem was wound down in early 2022 and its assets were sold.

OpenSea is an online marketplace for trading non-fungible tokens and digital collectibles. OpenSea charges fees on transactions conducted through its platform. OpenSea is operated by a company rather than by a fully autonomous smart contract system.

Wyre is a payments infrastructure company that offers fiat-to-crypto on- and off-ramp services. Wyre is operated as a centralized company that provides services to developers and businesses.

zkSync is a Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum. zkSync uses zero-knowledge rollups to process transactions off the main Ethereum chain while posting proofs to it. zkSync was developed by Matter Labs.

Synthetix is a DeFi protocol for issuing synthetic assets, known as synths, that track the value of other assets. Synthetix uses SNX tokens as collateral for issuing synths. Synthetix operates on Ethereum and on Optimism as a Layer 2 network.
